search_registries.description: List of registries to search when pulling unqualified images (e.g., 'nginx' without a prefix).

items.description: Mirror URL for the registry (must be valid registry URLs, e.g., 'mirror.example.com').

mirrors.description: List of fallback/mirror registries for this registry. Used for image pull failover.

insecure.description: If true, disables TLS verification and uses HTTP for this registry. Only for trusted local/test environments.

registries.description: Per-registry configuration blocks. Each entry defines settings (mirrors, TLS) for a specific registry.
